---
title: "World Cup Predictor Dataset Build"
format: pdf
---




```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(worldcup)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 1: Historical World Cup Win Rate Difference
# ============================================================

# Men's World Cup tournaments
mens_tournaments <- tournaments |>
  filter(
    str_detect(
      tournament_name,
      "Men's World Cup"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    year,
    start_date
  )


# Men's World Cup matches
matches <- worldcup::matches |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments,
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    year,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    home_team_code,
    home_team_name,
    away_team_code,
    away_team_name,
    home_team_score,
    away_team_score
  )


# One row per team per match
team_match_history <- bind_rows(

  matches |>
    transmute(
      tournament_id,
      year,
      match_id,
      match_date,
      team_code = home_team_code,
      team_name = home_team_name,
      goals_for = home_team_score,
      goals_against = away_team_score,
      win = as.integer(
        home_team_score > away_team_score
      )
    ),

  matches |>
    transmute(
      tournament_id,
      year,
      match_id,
      match_date,
      team_code = away_team_code,
      team_name = away_team_name,
      goals_for = away_team_score,
      goals_against = home_team_score,
      win = as.integer(
        away_team_score > home_team_score
      )
    )
)


# Teams appearing in each World Cup
teams_by_tournament <- team_match_history |>
  distinct(
    year,
    team_code,
    team_name
  )


# Historical World Cup win rate before each tournament
wc_win_rate_by_tournament <- map_dfr(
  sort(unique(teams_by_tournament$year)),
  function(target_year) {

    current_teams <- teams_by_tournament |>
      filter(year == target_year)

    prior_history <- team_match_history |>
      filter(year < target_year)

    current_teams |>
      left_join(
        prior_history |>
          group_by(team_code) |>
          summarise(
            prior_wc_matches = n(),
            prior_wc_wins = sum(win),
            .groups = "drop"
          ),
        by = "team_code"
      ) |>
      mutate(
        prior_wc_matches =
          replace_na(
            prior_wc_matches,
            0L
          ),

        prior_wc_wins =
          replace_na(
            prior_wc_wins,
            0
          ),

        wc_win_rate = if_else(
          prior_wc_matches > 0,
          prior_wc_wins / prior_wc_matches,
          0
        )
      ) |>
      select(
        year,
        team_code,
        wc_win_rate
      )
  }
)


# Home-team win rate
home_wc_win_rate <- wc_win_rate_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_wc_win_rate = wc_win_rate
  )


# Away-team win rate
away_wc_win_rate <- wc_win_rate_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_wc_win_rate = wc_win_rate
  )


# Add Predictor 1
world_cup_data <- matches |>
  left_join(
    home_wc_win_rate,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_wc_win_rate,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    wc_win_rate_diff =
      home_wc_win_rate -
      away_wc_win_rate
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 5: Previous World Cup Finish Difference
# ============================================================

# Add winner information to each tournament team
team_tournament_results <- qualified_teams |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      left_join(
        tournaments |>
          select(
            tournament_id,
            winner
          ),
        by = "tournament_id"
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  )


# Score each team's finish in every World Cup
finish_history <- team_tournament_results |>
  mutate(
    performance_clean =
      str_to_lower(performance),

    finish_score = case_when(

      team_name == winner ~ 6,

      performance_clean == "final" ~ 5,

      str_detect(
        performance_clean,
        "semi|third"
      ) ~ 4,

      str_detect(
        performance_clean,
        "quarter"
      ) ~ 3,

      str_detect(
        performance_clean,
        "round of sixteen|round of 16|second round|second group"
      ) ~ 2,

      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    team_code,
    year,
    finish_score
  )


# Previous World Cup finish for each team
previous_finish_by_tournament <- teams_by_tournament |>
  mutate(
    previous_year = year - 4
  ) |>
  left_join(
    finish_history,
    by = c(
      "team_code",
      "previous_year" = "year"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    previous_finish =
      replace_na(
        finish_score,
        0
      )
  ) |>
  select(
    year,
    team_code,
    previous_finish
  )


# Home-team previous finish
home_previous_finish <- previous_finish_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_previous_finish = previous_finish
  )


# Away-team previous finish
away_previous_finish <- previous_finish_by_tournament |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_previous_finish = previous_finish
  )


# Add Predictor 5
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_previous_finish,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_previous_finish,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    previous_finish_diff =
      home_previous_finish -
      away_previous_finish
  )  
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 6: Historical World Cup Head-to-Head Win Percentage
# ============================================================

# One row per team/opponent matchup
h2h_history <- bind_rows(

  matches |>
    transmute(
      year,
      team_code = home_team_code,
      opponent_code = away_team_code,
      win = as.integer(
        home_team_score > away_team_score
      )
    ),

  matches |>
    transmute(
      year,
      team_code = away_team_code,
      opponent_code = home_team_code,
      win = as.integer(
        away_team_score > home_team_score
      )
    )
)


# Historical H2H record frozen before each World Cup
h2h_by_tournament <- map_dfr(
  sort(unique(matches$year)),
  function(target_year) {

    current_matches <- matches |>
      filter(year == target_year) |>
      distinct(
        year,
        home_team_code,
        away_team_code
      )

    prior_h2h <- h2h_history |>
      filter(year < target_year) |>
      group_by(
        team_code,
        opponent_code
      ) |>
      summarise(
        h2h_matches = n(),
        h2h_wins = sum(win),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    current_matches |>
      left_join(
        prior_h2h,
        by = c(
          "home_team_code" = "team_code",
          "away_team_code" = "opponent_code"
        )
      ) |>
      mutate(
        h2h_matches =
          replace_na(
            h2h_matches,
            0L
          ),

        h2h_wins =
          replace_na(
            h2h_wins,
            0
          ),

        h2h_win_pct = if_else(
          h2h_matches > 0,
          h2h_wins / h2h_matches,
          0.5
        )
      ) |>
      select(
        year,
        home_team_code,
        away_team_code,
        h2h_win_pct
      )
  }
)


# Add Predictor 6
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    h2h_by_tournament,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_code",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 8: Host Advantage
# ============================================================

host_teams <- host_countries |>
  semi_join(
    mens_tournaments,
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  select(
    tournament_id,
    team_code
  ) |>
  distinct()


# Home-team host indicator
home_host <- host_teams |>
  transmute(
    tournament_id,
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_is_host = 1
  )


# Away-team host indicator
away_host <- host_teams |>
  transmute(
    tournament_id,
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_is_host = 1
  )


# Add Predictor 8
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_host,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_host,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_is_host = replace_na(home_is_host, 0),
    away_is_host = replace_na(away_is_host, 0),

    host_advantage =
      home_is_host -
      away_is_host
  )
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Predictor 12: Average Squad Age Difference
# ============================================================

squad_age <- squads |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      select(
        tournament_id,
        start_date
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    players |>
      select(
        player_id,
        birth_date
      ),
    by = "player_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    start_date = as.Date(start_date),
    birth_date = as.Date(birth_date),

    age = as.numeric(
      start_date - birth_date
    ) / 365.25
  ) |>
  group_by(
    tournament_id,
    team_code
  ) |>
  summarise(
    avg_squad_age = mean(
      age,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Home-team squad age
home_squad_age <- squad_age |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_avg_squad_age = avg_squad_age
  )


# Away-team squad age
away_squad_age <- squad_age |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_avg_squad_age = avg_squad_age
  )


# Add Predictor 12
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_squad_age,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_squad_age,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    avg_squad_age_diff =
      home_avg_squad_age -
      away_avg_squad_age
  )

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 13: Squad World Cup Experience Difference
# ============================================================

# Count WC matches played by each player
# in each tournament
player_wc_apps <- player_appearances |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      select(
        tournament_id,
        year
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  count(
    player_id,
    tournament_id,
    year,
    name = "wc_match_apps"
  )


# Previous WC experience for every squad player
player_tournament_history <- squads |>
  inner_join(
    mens_tournaments |>
      select(
        tournament_id,
        year
      ),
    by = "tournament_id"
  ) |>
  distinct(
    player_id,
    tournament_id,
    year,
    team_code
  ) |>
  left_join(
    player_wc_apps,
    by = c(
      "player_id",
      "tournament_id",
      "year"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    wc_match_apps =
      replace_na(
        wc_match_apps,
        0
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(player_id) |>
  arrange(
    year,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prior_player_wc_apps =
      lag(
        cumsum(wc_match_apps),
        default = 0
      )
  ) |>
  ungroup()


# Average previous WC experience for each squad
squad_experience <- player_tournament_history |>
  group_by(
    tournament_id,
    team_code
  ) |>
  summarise(
    squad_wc_experience =
      mean(prior_player_wc_apps),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Home-team squad experience
home_squad_experience <- squad_experience |>
  rename(
    home_team_code = team_code,
    home_squad_wc_experience =
      squad_wc_experience
  )


# Away-team squad experience
away_squad_experience <- squad_experience |>
  rename(
    away_team_code = team_code,
    away_squad_wc_experience =
      squad_wc_experience
  )


# Add Predictor 13
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_squad_experience,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "home_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_squad_experience,
    by = c(
      "tournament_id",
      "away_team_code"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    squad_wc_experience_diff =
      home_squad_wc_experience -
      away_squad_wc_experience
  )
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Predictor 14: Pre-Tournament Elo Difference
# ============================================================

# Clean team names for Elo matching
elo_team_key <- function(x) {

  x <- x |>
    str_squish() |>
    stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ") |>
    str_squish()

  case_when(
    x %in% c(
      "usa",
      "united states of america"
    ) ~ "united states",

    x %in% c(
      "korea republic",
      "republic of korea"
    ) ~ "south korea",

    x == "ir iran" ~ "iran",

    x %in% c(
      "cote d ivoire",
      "ivory coast"
    ) ~ "ivory coast",

    x == "turkiye" ~ "turkey",

    x == "czechia" ~ "czech republic",

    x == "china pr" ~ "china",

    x == "cabo verde" ~ "cape verde",

    x %in% c(
      "congo dr",
      "dr congo"
    ) ~ "dr congo",

    x == "west germany" ~ "germany",

    TRUE ~ x
  )
}


# Function to get Elo ratings for one date
get_frozen_elo <- function(date) {

  date <- as.Date(date)

  url <- paste0(
    "https://www.international-football.net/elo-ratings-table?",
    "year=", lubridate::year(date),
    "&month=", sprintf(
      "%02d",
      lubridate::month(date)
    ),
    "&day=", sprintf(
      "%02d",
      lubridate::day(date)
    )
  )

  rows <- read_html(url) |>
    html_elements("table tr")

  map_dfr(
    rows,
    function(row) {

      cells <- row |>
        html_elements("td") |>
        html_text2()

      if (length(cells) < 3) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      rating <- suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          str_extract(
            cells[length(cells)],
            "\\d{3,4}"
          )
        )
      )

      team <- cells[length(cells) - 1]

      if (
        is.na(rating) ||
        team == "" ||
        !str_detect(team, "[A-Za-z]")
      ) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      tibble(
        team_key = elo_team_key(team),
        elo = rating
      )
    }
  ) |>
    distinct(
      team_key,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
}


# Elo snapshot from the day before each World Cup
elo_snapshots <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(mens_tournaments)),
  function(i) {

    target_year <-
      mens_tournaments$year[i]

    snapshot_date <-
      as.Date(
        mens_tournaments$start_date[i]
      ) - 1

    get_frozen_elo(snapshot_date) |>
      mutate(
        year = target_year
      )
  }
)


# Home-team Elo
home_elo <- world_cup_data |>
  distinct(
    year,
    home_team_name
  ) |>
  mutate(
    team_key =
      elo_team_key(
        home_team_name
      )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    elo_snapshots,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "team_key"
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    year,
    home_team_name,
    home_elo = elo
  )


# Away-team Elo
away_elo <- world_cup_data |>
  distinct(
    year,
    away_team_name
  ) |>
  mutate(
    team_key =
      elo_team_key(
        away_team_name
      )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    elo_snapshots,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "team_key"
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    year,
    away_team_name,
    away_elo = elo
  )


# Add Predictor 14
world_cup_data <- world_cup_data |>
  left_join(
    home_elo,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "home_team_name"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    away_elo,
    by = c(
      "year",
      "away_team_name"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    elo_diff =
      home_elo -
      away_elo
  )
```
